hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Set this state's '_firstFlag' to true.
Call arg.

If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let number be the numeric entry "prob_of_transit_normal_to_straight" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
  If not this state's '_firstFlag' and util passes a fraction roll of number, then choose state 21 next.
  Otherwise
    The enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
    Set this state's '_firstFlag' to false.

flow.text: the enemy is ready to act

yes.text: Let number be the numeric entry "prob_of_transit_normal_to_straight" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
not this state's '_firstFlag' and util passes a fraction roll of number

no.text: The enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
